prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / stylized-concept.
Asset type: isolated foreground illustration for the Pirogorsk disposable tableware product card.
Primary request: a beautiful original editorial watercolour illustration of a small tidy stack of plain unbranded cream disposable plates, a simple pale wooden fork and spoon, and a folded ivory paper napkin. No food, no drink, no packaging.
Style: refined realistic watercolour and soft pencil detail, the warm tactile food-illustration art direction of a Baltic bakery, restrained marine-blue shadows, warm cream paper tones, an elegant compact arrangement seen from a slightly elevated three-quarter view.
Composition: square canvas with the full objects centred and visible, a compact group occupying approximately 75 percent of the canvas, no clipped edges. Only a subtle soft contact shadow under the objects. Transparent background, clean natural alpha edges, no rectangular ground or paper backdrop, no surrounding ingredient border.
Constraints: no typography, letters, numbers, logos or watermark; no decorative motifs, no additional objects.
